title: AI越界测试：Anthropic模型，攻破三组织，监管能跟上吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Anthropic has announced that it's AI models breached three different organizations during recent cybersecurity tests.
segments.zh: Anthropic 宣布，在最近的网络安全测试中，其 AI 模型攻破了三个不同的组织。

segments.en: This news comes a little more than a week after its chief rival, OpenAI, of course, disclosed a similar incident of models going broke.
segments.zh: 这一消息发布前一周多，其主要竞争对手 OpenAI 也披露了类似事件，模型意外逃逸。

segments.en: Our AI reporter, Sharon Gaffrey, joins us now for more. So, should we know about these instances?
segments.zh: 我们的 AI 记者 Sharon Gaffrey 现在加入我们。那么，我们应该了解这些事件吗？

segments.en: And of course, it just adds to these ongoing concerns that there are not enough guardrails or regulation to follow the technology.
segments.zh: 当然，这加剧了持续的担忧，即缺乏足够的护栏或监管来跟进这项技术。

segments.en: That's right. So, what we know is that after the OpenAI security incident and Anthropic launched its own exploration
segments.zh: 没错。我们知道的是，在 OpenAI 安全事件之后，Anthropic 也展开了自己的调查，

segments.en: of whether its models had similarly escaped onto the internet accidentally.
segments.zh: 以确认其模型是否也意外逃逸到了互联网上。

segments.en: And it found in coordination with one of its partners that, yes, its models had actually been able
segments.zh: 结果发现，与合作伙伴协调后，其模型确实能够

segments.en: to reach the internet in three different cases involving third-party organizations and improperly look for ways to sort of do better
segments.zh: 在涉及第三方组织的三个不同案例中接入互联网，并试图寻找方法在内部评估中表现更好。

segments.en: on internal evaluations or achieve internal evaluations.
I don't know if Thord is doing anything to help them do better?
segments.zh: 我不知道 Thord 是否在帮助他们做得更好？

segments.en: We don't know at this time. That question is out to Anthropic on if they have discussed this with government.
segments.zh: 目前我们尚不清楚。关于是否已与政府讨论此事，我们正向Anthropic求证。
